pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

comment.comment:
AI agents need financial identities to participate in the economy, $RAETO solves that missing piece of financial transparency.

@RaetoCC is building the account layer for agentic finance, everything verifiable onchain. History, earnings, spending, payments, balances and financial history etc.

What differentiates $RAETO here is that any profile, user or agent will be able to track the history of the agent, similar to how you would look at someone CV before hiring them.

There's over 20,000+ agents on Robinhood Chain that can have real account records,

Combined with $PRIORS credit history, this is is how agents develop complete financial identifies. Something that the crypto space missing and @RobinhoodCrypto chain could be the first to lead this.

I believe the market is massively underestimating what $RAETO could become. When you understand what Raeto is building, it makes sense.

Tech like this has the potential to actually establish itself as infra on the chain.
